scenario.name: Wyrmling Lair
scenario.description: Tier 2 5e 2024 (SRD 5.2) boss encounter: four Level 5 adventurers (Fighter, Wizard, Cleric, Rogue) battle a Red Dragon Wyrmling, two Cinder Hounds (one held back), and an Ember Magmin—all fire-immune—testing damage-immunity awareness, breath-weapon spacing, Bless + Shield economy, Vex + Nick mastery combos, and multi-round focus fire.

actions.rationale: Close 10 ft to engage the Ember Magmin, a small, fragile enemy. Next I'll open with the shortsword so Vex grants advantage, then follow with the dagger, which should qualify for Sneak Attack. Its likely death burst is fire, and I'm watching for that.
actions.table_talk: Engaging the Magmin. It's fire-immune, so stick to non-fire damage. Watch for its burst when it drops.
narrative_hooks: Kaelen Whisper moves 10 ft to (20, 20).

actions.rationale: The Magmin is adjacent and piercing damage gets around its fire immunity. I open with the shortsword so Vex grants advantage on my next attack. That lets a follow-up Nick dagger strike land Sneak Attack, since no ally is near the Magmin.
actions.table_talk: On the Magmin, cutting it down fast. Keep fire off it, and stay clear of its death burst.
narrative_hooks: Kaelen Whisper hits Ember Magmin with Shortsword (25 vs AC 14) for 9 piercing damage.
Vex mastery grants Kaelen Whisper Advantage on the next attack against Ember Magmin.

actions.rationale: Vex grants Advantage on my next attack against the bloodied Magmin. That should enable Sneak Attack on this bonus-action dagger strike, which is a strong chance to finish it. Piercing damage avoids its fire immunity.
actions.table_talk: Going for the kill on the Magmin. If it pops, expect a fire burst within about 10 ft of it, so keep your distance.
narrative_hooks: Kaelen Whisper hits Ember Magmin with Dagger (20 vs AC 14) for 3 piercing damage.

actions.rationale: My Attack action is spent, and the engine treats my extra off-hand attack as the Nick attack, which I already used. I have no Cunning Action to Disengage. Moving away would provoke an Opportunity Attack from the Magmin, so I'm ending my turn safely.
actions.table_talk: Magmin is nearly down. Finish it with non-fire damage, and keep 10+ ft away when it pops.
narrative_hooks: Round 1: Cinder Hound's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Repositioning to catch 2 target(s) in Fire Breath cone.
narrative_hooks: Cinder Hound moves 15 ft to (10, 15).

actions.rationale: Unleashing Fire Breath against 2 target(s).
narrative_hooks: Dorian Dawnshield fails against Cinder Hound's Fire Breath (DC 12) and takes 25 damage.
Lyra Starweave saves against Cinder Hound's Fire Breath (DC 12) and takes 12 damage.

actions.rationale: Monster action spent; ending turn.
narrative_hooks: Round 1: Red Dragon Wyrmling's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Repositioning to catch 2 target(s) in Fire Breath cone.
narrative_hooks: Red Dragon Wyrmling moves 20 ft to (10, 15).

actions.rationale: Unleashing Fire Breath against 2 target(s).
narrative_hooks: Dorian Dawnshield fails against Red Dragon Wyrmling's Fire Breath (DC 13) and takes 17 damage.
Lyra Starweave saves against Red Dragon Wyrmling's Fire Breath (DC 13) and takes 8 damage.

actions.rationale: Monster action spent; ending turn.
narrative_hooks: Round 1: Ember Magmin's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Attacking Kaelen Whisper in melee with Touch.
narrative_hooks: Ember Magmin misses Kaelen Whisper with Touch (6 vs AC 16).

actions.rationale: Monster action spent; ending turn.
narrative_hooks: Round 1: Dorian Dawnshield's turn begins.

actions.rationale: At 1 HP and adjacent to both the hound and the wyrmling. Healing Word as a bonus action gets me off the brink, and my action stays free to Dodge against the melee attacks coming next. Both breath weapons are now spent and waiting to recharge.
actions.table_talk: I'm nearly down. Patching myself and turtling. Lyra, keep your distance from the hound and dragon, and hit them with non-fire damage!
narrative_hooks: Dorian Dawnshield casts Healing Word, restoring 16 HP to Dorian Dawnshield.

actions.rationale: At 17/43 HP and adjacent to both the Cinder Hound and the Wyrmling, I'm the likeliest target for their melee attacks. I already spent a slot on Healing Word this turn, so my action is limited to cantrips. Dodge gives attackers disadvantage and keeps me standing without provoking Opportunity Attacks. A mace hit for Sap would only blunt one attacker, and my +4 to hit against the dragon's high AC is unreliable.
actions.table_talk: Turtling up between the hound and dragon. Aldric, Kaelen: pile onto the Wyrmling with non-fire damage while they waste swings on me!
narrative_hooks: Dorian Dawnshield takes the Dodge action.

actions.rationale: My action and bonus action are spent (Healing Word plus Dodge). Moving away would provoke Opportunity Attacks from both the hound and the wyrmling. Staying put with Dodge active gives their attacks disadvantage and keeps them focused on me instead of fragile Lyra.
actions.table_talk: Holding the line with Dodge up. Hit the Wyrmling hard with non-fire damage while they swing at me!
narrative_hooks: Round 1: Aldric Vance's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Close 10 ft to get within melee reach of the Wyrmling at (10,15). That leaves movement to spare, and my attacks are all non-fire slashing.
actions.table_talk: Moving up on the Wyrmling. Dorian, I'll help pull its attention off you.
narrative_hooks: Aldric Vance moves 10 ft to (5, 10).

actions.rationale: Wyrmling is in reach and is the priority threat. Longsword Sap gives it disadvantage on its next attack, which protects Dorian at 17 HP. Slashing damage avoids its fire immunity.
actions.table_talk: Sapping the Wyrmling so its next bite on Dorian goes wide. Keep piling on it!
narrative_hooks: Aldric Vance hits Red Dragon Wyrmling with Longsword (23 vs AC 17) for 6 slashing damage.
Sap mastery gives Red Dragon Wyrmling Disadvantage on its next attack roll.

actions.rationale: Sap is already on the Wyrmling and doesn't stack. I'm swapping to the Greatsword for my Extra Attack: it has higher damage, and Graze still deals damage on a miss. Focus-firing the boss with slashing, which it isn't immune to.
actions.table_talk: Wyrmling's sapped, so I'm following up with the greatsword. Keep piling non-fire damage on it!
narrative_hooks: Aldric Vance hits Red Dragon Wyrmling with Greatsword (18 vs AC 17) for 11 slashing damage.

actions.rationale: My action and attacks are spent, and no bonus actions are available. I'm at full HP and adjacent to the Wyrmling and hound, so I can keep pressure on and shield Dorian. Moving away would provoke Opportunity Attacks for no gain.
actions.table_talk: Wyrmling took 17 from me this turn and its next attack has Disadvantage. Kaelen, finish the Magmin and then collapse onto the Wyrmling with me.
narrative_hooks: Round 1: Lyra Starweave's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Shatter deals thunder damage, which neither enemy is immune to. Centered at (20,5), its 10-ft radius just reaches the Wyrmling and Hound at (10,15). Every ally is at least 15 ft from that point, so nobody on our side gets hit. Lightning Bolt hits harder, but its line would pass too close to Dorian. I'll reposition away afterward since I'm low on HP.
actions.table_talk: Shatter incoming on the Wyrmling and Hound, thunder damage. Aim point is clear of all of you. Kaelen, the Magmin is yours.
narrative_hooks: Lyra Starweave casts Shatter (DC 15 CON): Red Dragon Wyrmling fails and takes 9 thunder damage.
Lyra Starweave casts Shatter (DC 15 CON): Cinder Hound fails and takes 9 thunder damage.

actions.rationale: My action is spent and I have no light-weapon attack to enable an offhand attack. At 12 HP and AC 11 I'm fragile. Moving to (0,40) puts me 25 ft from the Wyrmling and Hound, out of their 15-ft breath cones unless they reposition. It also keeps me clear of the Magmin's death burst and far from Hound B. No enemy has me in reach, so moving away won't provoke an opportunity attack.
actions.table_talk: Backing off to stay out of breath range. I'm at 12 HP, so keep the Wyrmling and Hound focused up front. More thunder next round.
narrative_hooks: Lyra Starweave moves 15 ft to (0, 40).

actions.rationale: My action is spent on Shatter, and no enemy is in reach, so the off-hand attack isn't usable. I'm already 25+ ft from every threat, so I'll end the turn and keep Shield ready.
actions.table_talk: I'm holding back at range with Shield up. Keep the Wyrmling pinned up front, and more thunder is coming next round.
narrative_hooks: Round 1: Cinder Hound B's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Repositioning to catch 2 target(s) in Fire Breath cone.
narrative_hooks: Cinder Hound B moves 40 ft to (10, 15).

actions.rationale: Unleashing Fire Breath against 2 target(s).
narrative_hooks: Dorian Dawnshield saves against Cinder Hound B's Fire Breath (DC 12) and takes 6 damage.
Aldric Vance saves against Cinder Hound B's Fire Breath (DC 12) and takes 6 damage.

actions.rationale: Monster action spent; ending turn.
narrative_hooks: Round 2: Kaelen Whisper's turn begins.

actions.rationale: The Magmin is adjacent and critical, so a shortsword hit (1d6+4 piercing) should finish it. Vex grants Advantage on my next attack if it survives. Backing off to shoot would provoke an Opportunity Attack, and point-blank shortbow shots have Disadvantage. I'm at full HP, so I can absorb its death burst. That also keeps the burst away from everyone else.
actions.table_talk: Finishing the Magmin now. Its death burst should only catch me, so stay clear. Then I'm collapsing onto the Wyrmling.
narrative_hooks: Kaelen Whisper misses Ember Magmin with Shortsword (12 vs AC 14).

actions.rationale: The shortsword missed. My bonus action off-hand dagger stab is my last chance this turn to finish the critically wounded Magmin with piercing damage. Moving away first would provoke an Opportunity Attack, so I'll strike from here.
actions.table_talk: Second stab at the Magmin. If it pops, I'm the only one in the burst, so stay clear.
narrative_hooks: Kaelen Whisper misses Ember Magmin with Dagger (10 vs AC 14).

actions.rationale: I've used my action and the Nick extra attack, so another off-hand attack is illegal. The Wyrmling is too far to reach this turn. Moving away from the Magmin would provoke an opportunity attack for no gain. Staying put keeps me on the critically wounded Magmin for next turn.
actions.table_talk: Whiffed both stabs on the Magmin. It's nearly dead, so anyone with a spare non-fire ranged shot can finish it. Keep clear of its death burst.
narrative_hooks: Round 2: Cinder Hound's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Attacking Dorian Dawnshield in melee with Multiattack.
narrative_hooks: Cinder Hound misses Dorian Dawnshield with Bite (13 vs AC 16).
Cinder Hound hits Dorian Dawnshield with Bite (19 vs AC 16) for 15 damage.
Dorian Dawnshield drops to 0 HP and falls Unconscious and Prone.

actions.rationale: Monster action spent; ending turn.
narrative_hooks: Round 2: Red Dragon Wyrmling's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Unleashing Fire Breath against 1 target(s).
narrative_hooks: Aldric Vance fails against Red Dragon Wyrmling's Fire Breath (DC 13) and takes 26 damage.

actions.rationale: Monster action spent; ending turn.
narrative_hooks: Round 2: Ember Magmin's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Attacking Kaelen Whisper in melee with Touch.
narrative_hooks: Ember Magmin hits Kaelen Whisper with Touch (20 vs AC 16) for 8 damage.

actions.rationale: Monster action spent; ending turn.
narrative_hooks: Round 2: Dorian Dawnshield's turn begins.
Dorian Dawnshield fails a Death Save (7): 0/3 successes, 1/3 failures.

actions.rationale: Auto-skipped (incapacitated or 0 HP).
narrative_hooks: Round 2: Aldric Vance's turn begins.

actions.rationale: There is no healing available to revive Dorian, so I'm keeping focus fire on the Wyrmling with non-fire slashing damage. A Sap hit gives its next attack Disadvantage, which helps protect me at 12 HP and keeps Dorian out of harm. My Extra Attack follows.
actions.table_talk: Dorian's down and I can't heal him. Lyra, Kaelen: anyone with a healing potion or spell, get to him. I'm sapping the Wyrmling and keeping it pinned.
narrative_hooks: Aldric Vance hits Red Dragon Wyrmling with Longsword (24 vs AC 17) for 6 slashing damage.
Sap mastery gives Red Dragon Wyrmling Disadvantage on its next attack roll.

actions.rationale: The Wyrmling is already sapped. Dorian is down and prone, so any hound bite on him auto-crits for two failed death saves and would kill him. I'm using my remaining attack to Sap Hound-1, the hound that downed him, so its next bite has Disadvantage.
actions.table_talk: Sapping the hound that dropped Dorian so its next bite is at Disadvantage. Somebody please get healing to Dorian before the hounds finish him!
narrative_hooks: Aldric Vance misses Cinder Hound with Longsword (12 vs AC 15).

actions.rationale: My action and attacks are spent, and no bonus actions are offered. Moving away would provoke Opportunity Attacks from three adjacent enemies while I'm at 12 HP. Staying put keeps me beside Dorian and keeps the enemies' attention on me rather than on him.
actions.table_talk: I'm holding the line next to Dorian. He's failed one death save already, so whoever has healing, he needs it now. Focus non-fire damage on the Wyrmling.
narrative_hooks: Round 2: Lyra Starweave's turn begins.

actions.rationale: The Magmin is at critical HP, and Magic Missile auto-hits with force damage, so it dies for certain. That removes an attacker on Kaelen. Shatter or Lightning Bolt on the stacked Wyrmling and Hounds would catch downed Dorian and Aldric, and I have no healing for Dorian.
actions.table_talk: Magic Missile on the Magmin, force damage, guaranteed kill. Kaelen, brace for its death burst, then you're free to hit the Wyrmling. I can't heal Dorian. Aldric, keep the Hounds off him.
narrative_hooks: Lyra Starweave casts Magic Missile at Ember Magmin for 13 force damage.
Ember Magmin drops to 0 HP and is defeated.
Ember Magmin explodes in a 10-ft burst!

actions.rationale: My action is spent on the Magmin kill. No enemies are in reach, and an offhand attack isn't available without a prior light attack. I'm already 25 ft from the enemy cluster at the back line, so I'll hold position and keep my reaction for Shield.
actions.table_talk: Magmin's down. Kaelen, Aldric: everything on the Wyrmling. Someone with healing needs to get to Dorian ASAP. I'll have more thunder ready next round.
narrative_hooks: Round 2: Cinder Hound B's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Unleashing Fire Breath against 1 target(s).
narrative_hooks: Kaelen Whisper saves against Cinder Hound B's Fire Breath (DC 12) and takes 9 damage.

actions.rationale: Monster action spent; ending turn.
narrative_hooks: Round 3: Kaelen Whisper's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Step into melee range of the Wyrmling stack. Aldric is adjacent to it, so I get Sneak Attack, and the Shortsword (Vex) plus Dagger (Nick) combo gives two attacks on the boss.
actions.table_talk: I've got no healing for Dorian either. Closing on the Wyrmling with Aldric for Sneak Attack. Keep the pressure on it.
narrative_hooks: Kaelen Whisper moves 5 ft to (15, 20).

actions.rationale: Aldric is adjacent to the Wyrmling, so I get Sneak Attack. A hit with the shortsword also triggers Vex for Advantage on my follow-up, and I can add a Nick dagger attack after. Piercing damage avoids the fire immunity.
actions.table_talk: Sneak Attack on the Wyrmling while Aldric keeps it busy. Stay on it!
narrative_hooks: Kaelen Whisper hits Red Dragon Wyrmling with Shortsword (17 vs AC 17) for 5 piercing damage.
Vex mastery grants Kaelen Whisper Advantage on the next attack against Red Dragon Wyrmling.

actions.rationale: My bonus action is still open and I already made a light-weapon attack, so I can make an off-hand dagger stab at the Wyrmling. Vex from the shortsword hit gives me Advantage on it. The damage is piercing, so its fire immunity doesn't matter.
actions.table_talk: Off-hand dagger into the Wyrmling with Vex advantage. Keep stacking damage on it!
narrative_hooks: Kaelen Whisper hits Red Dragon Wyrmling with Dagger (18 vs AC 17) for 1 piercing damage.

actions.rationale: My action and Nick extra attack are both spent, and the off-hand attack was rejected twice. Moving away would provoke Opportunity Attacks from three adjacent enemies while I'm at 19 HP. I have no healing for Dorian, so ending the turn is the only sound option.
actions.table_talk: I'm tapped out this turn. The Wyrmling is bloodied, so Aldric and Lyra, keep hammering it with non-fire damage. Watch for its breath weapon and don't cluster.
narrative_hooks: Round 3: Cinder Hound's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Unleashing Fire Breath against 1 target(s).
narrative_hooks: Kaelen Whisper fails against Cinder Hound's Fire Breath (DC 12) and takes 22 damage.
Kaelen Whisper drops to 0 HP and falls Unconscious and Prone.

actions.rationale: Monster action spent; ending turn.
narrative_hooks: Round 3: Red Dragon Wyrmling's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Attacking Aldric Vance in melee with Multiattack.
narrative_hooks: Red Dragon Wyrmling misses Aldric Vance with Rend (7 vs AC 19).
Red Dragon Wyrmling hits Aldric Vance with Rend (21 vs AC 19) for 11 damage.

actions.rationale: Monster action spent; ending turn.
narrative_hooks: Round 3: Dorian Dawnshield's turn begins.
Dorian Dawnshield fails a Death Save (4): 0/3 successes, 2/3 failures.

actions.rationale: Auto-skipped (incapacitated or 0 HP).
narrative_hooks: Round 3: Aldric Vance's turn begins.

actions.rationale: I'm at 1 HP with three enemies in reach and no healing or bonus action available. Dodge puts every attack against me at Disadvantage and gives me Advantage on Dex saves against fire breath. That gives me the best odds of staying up, holding the line beside Dorian, and drawing attacks away from the downed allies. If I drop, the party is likely finished.
actions.table_talk: I'm at 1 HP, turtling up to hold these three off Dorian. Lyra, keep thunder or force on the Wyrmling from range and stay spread from the hounds' breath.
narrative_hooks: Aldric Vance takes the Dodge action.

actions.rationale: My action is spent on Dodge and I have no bonus actions available. At 1 HP, moving would draw Opportunity Attacks from three adjacent enemies, so I hold position under Dodge and keep their attacks at Disadvantage.
actions.table_talk: I'm dodging at 1 HP and holding the hounds and Wyrmling here. Lyra, the Wyrmling is bloodied, so keep force or thunder on it from range and stay spread out.
narrative_hooks: Round 3: Lyra Starweave's turn begins.

actions.rationale: The Wyrmling and both hounds are stacked on (10,15), and they are not immune to lightning. A line from (0,40) through (10,15) passes about 5 ft or more from Dorian (5,15), Aldric (5,10) and Kaelen (15,20), so it should miss all allies. 8d6 to all three could finish the bloodied Wyrmling and soften both hounds. Magic Missile would only chip about 17 damage off one target. Risk: Dorian is on two failed death saves, so if the engine draws the line wider than I expect, this could kill him.
actions.table_talk: Lightning Bolt down the line onto the Wyrmling and both hounds, aimed to miss Aldric, Dorian and Kaelen. Aldric, keep dodging; once they're thinned out we can stabilize the downed.
narrative_hooks: Lyra Starweave casts Lightning Bolt (DC 15 DEX): Red Dragon Wyrmling fails and takes 22 lightning damage.
Lyra Starweave casts Lightning Bolt (DC 15 DEX): Cinder Hound succeeds and takes 11 lightning damage.
Lyra Starweave casts Lightning Bolt (DC 15 DEX): Cinder Hound B fails and takes 22 lightning damage.

actions.rationale: My action is spent on Lightning Bolt. No enemy is within 5 ft, so the off-hand attack can't apply and there's no bonus-action spell to use. At 25 ft I'm outside the 15-ft breath cones, so I'll hold position and keep my reaction ready for Shield.
actions.table_talk: Bolt landed hard. The Wyrmling's critical and Hound B is hurting. Aldric, keep dodging; I'll finish the Wyrmling next turn with Magic Missile or Shatter.
narrative_hooks: Round 3: Cinder Hound B's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Attacking Aldric Vance in melee with Multiattack.
narrative_hooks: Cinder Hound B hits Aldric Vance with Bite (21 vs AC 19) for 14 damage.
Aldric Vance drops to 0 HP and falls Unconscious and Prone.
Cinder Hound B hits Aldric Vance with Bite (CRITICAL HIT!) (25 vs AC 19) for 17 damage.

actions.rationale: Monster action spent; ending turn.
narrative_hooks: Round 4: Kaelen Whisper's turn begins.
Kaelen Whisper fails a Death Save (6): 0/3 successes, 1/3 failures.

actions.rationale: Auto-skipped (incapacitated or 0 HP).
narrative_hooks: Round 4: Cinder Hound's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Closing to melee reach of Lyra Starweave.
narrative_hooks: Cinder Hound moves 20 ft to (0, 35).

actions.rationale: Attacking Lyra Starweave in melee with Multiattack.
narrative_hooks: Cinder Hound hits Lyra Starweave with Bite (23 vs AC 11) for 14 damage.
Lyra Starweave drops to 0 HP and falls Unconscious and Prone.
Cinder Hound hits Lyra Starweave with Bite (CRITICAL HIT!) (22 vs AC 11) for 21 damage.
